sn12.82:1.2: “Bhikkhus, one who does not know and see as it really is aging-and-death,
sn12.82:1.5: and the way leading to its cessation, should search for a teacher in order to know this as it really is. “Bhikkhus, one who does not know and see as it really is birth … existence … clinging … craving … feeling … contact … the six sense bases … name-and-form … consciousness … volitional formations, their origin, their cessation, and the way leading to their cessation, should search for a teacher in order to know this as it really is.”
